answer_1.quote: We analyzed the SummEval dataset , a benchmark for summarization tasks. The benchmark contains 1700 summaries generated by 17 models on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset.

answer_2.quote: We ran 16 types of popular automatic metrics that include rule-based metrics, embedding-based metrics, end-to-end metrics, and LLM-based metrics that are reference-based or reference-free...

answer_3.quote: Metrics with non-deterministic algorithms, such as LLM-based metrics G-Eval, displayed higher levels of measurement error in terms of Metric Stability.

answer_4.quote: each generated summary was rated by three experts, who provided 5-point-scale ratings on four dimensions: Coherence, Consistency, Fluency, and Relevance.
answer_4.guideline: 5-point-scale ratings on four dimensions: Coherence, Consistency, Fluency, and Relevance
